root_cause.text: The use of bitfields (`has_lease`, `is_open`, `on_list`) in `struct cached_fid` allows concurrent updates on different CPUs to trigger read-modify-write (RMW) race conditions, potentially restoring stale flag values.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `fs/smb/client/cached_dir.h` replaces the single-bit bitfields (`bool has_lease:1`, `bool is_open:1`, `bool on_list:1`, and `bool file_all_info_is_valid:1`) in `struct cached_fid` with individual `bool` fields to prevent shared-byte RMW operations.
